command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/tmp/omega-pr104-current
rm -rf "$ROOT"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT" -- --quiet
cd "$ROOT"
git fetch -q origin chatgpt-gpt56sol-omega-final-policy-main-20260913
git checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo HEAD=$HEAD
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
python3 -m py_compile scripts/voice_777_runtime.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_voice_777_runtime_authority.py tests/test_omega_final_acoustic_authority.py tests/test_voice777_effect_authority_separation.py tests/test_omega_arm_bus.py tests/test_voice777_local_audio_arm.py tests/test_voice_omega_retrieval.py
printf 'PR104_VALIDATED_HEAD=%s TREE=%s\n' "$HEAD" "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"
